summary: Filter groups after calculating their totals.
syntax: SELECT key, SUM(amount) AS total FROM table_name GROUP BY key HAVING SUM(amount) >= threshold;
documentation: HAVING filters aggregate groups after grouping. WHERE instead filters individual input rows before aggregation.
inputs: Grouped rows and an aggregate condition.
returns: Only the groups that pass the condition.
caution: Filtering individual rows with WHERE can change a total before HAVING evaluates it. Pick the stage that matches the question.
scenarios: Find customers whose combined spend exceeds a threshold.
Identify categories with enough orders to report.
Flag technicians whose total workload exceeds capacity.
title: Find customers above the spending threshold
problem: Return customer and SUM(amount_cents) AS total_cents for customers with a combined total of at least 1000 cents, ordered by customer ascending. Amounts are non-NULL integers.
goal: Use HAVING or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
hint: Group by customer and put the sum condition in HAVING.
